rows.meaning: citizenship; legal membership of a nation
rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for legal nationality or citizenship.

example.english: When you fill in the form, you need to write your nationality.
example.jyutping: nei5 tin4 biu2 go2 zan6 jiu3 se2 gwok3 zik6

rows.note: Use this for a people defined by shared origin, culture, or language rather than legal citizenship.
